fhir_base_url.title: FHIR Base URL
fhir_base_url.description: Your Epic FHIR R4 base URL.

client_id.title: OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: The Client ID from your Epic app.

private_key.title: RSA Private Key
private_key.description: The RSA private key for your Epic app.

kid.title: Key ID (kid)
kid.description: The Key ID for your Epic app's public key.

algorithm.title: JWT Signing Algorithm
algorithm.description: The signing algorithm used for OAuth authentication.

audience.title: JWT Audience (aud)
audience.description: Optional. Defaults to your OAuth Token URL.

scope.title: OAuth Scope
scope.description: Optional. The OAuth scopes requested from Epic.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Optional. Comma-separated FHIR resources to export, such as Patient, Observation, or Condition.

export_group_id.title: Bulk Export Group ID
export_group_id.description: The Epic Group ID used for Bulk Data exports.

export_since.title: Export Since
export_since.description: Optional. Only export resources changed after this date and time.

export_poll_interval.title: Export Poll Interval (seconds)
export_poll_interval.description: How often to check the export status.

export_timeout.title: Export Timeout (seconds)
export_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for an export to complete. Must be greater than 0 and at most 120.

timeout.title: HTTP Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for an API response.
